verdict.rationale: The sampled SKILL.md files state what each skill does: ledger-tasks retrieves records and manages tasks, ralph-loop executes one assigned task, and understand-project inspects architecture. Some give activation cues, such as "before planning or implementing a requested change" and "exactly one explicitly assigned" task. The validator also checks "invocation contracts" across skills, which suggests activation conditions are formalized. However, only three of the eight skills are evidenced, and explicit activation triggers are thin. missing for 10: evidence that all eight skills document purpose and activation triggers, explicit when-to-activate sections or examples of the invocation contracts, independent or hands-on corroboration that agent behavior matches the documented triggers.
